description_en: Retrieves the details of a workspace
description_zh: 获取工作空间详细信息
name: GetWorkspace

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return additional information, such as the workspace owner. Valid values:

false (default): Does not return additional information.

true: Returns additional information
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示工作空间Owner等补充信息。取值如下：
false（默认值）：不显示补充信息。
true：显示补充信息
parameters.name: verbose

AdminNames.description_en: The list of administrator account names

items.description_en: The administrator account name. This parameter is returned only when Verbose is set to true
items.description_zh: 管理员账户名称。当Verbose为true时显示

Creator.description_en: The ID of the user who created the workspace

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the workspace

EnvTypes.description_en:
The environments that the workspace contains. Valid values:

A workspace in basic mode has only the production environment (prod).

A workspace in standard mode has both the development environment (dev) and the production environment (prod)
EnvTypes.description_zh:
工作空间包含的环境，取值如下：

简单模式只有生产环境（prod）。
标准模式包含开发环境（dev）和生产环境（prod）

items.description_en:
The environment type. Valid values:

dev: the development environment.

prod: the production environment
items.description_zh:
环境类型，可能值：

dev：开发环境。
prod：生产环境

EnvTypes.title_en: 环境，用作判断简单模式还是标准模式
EnvTypes.title_zh: 环境，用作判断简单模式还是标准模式

ExtraInfos.description_en: Additional information. This parameter currently contains the tenant ID (TenantId)
ExtraInfos.description_zh: 附加信息，目前包含TenantId（租户ID）

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the workspace was created. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 工作空间创建UTC时间，时间格式为ISO8601
GmtCreateTime.title_en: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
GmtCreateTime.title_zh: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the workspace was last modified. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: 工作空间修改UTC时间，时间格式为ISO8601
GmtModifiedTime.title_en: 修改 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
GmtModifiedTime.title_zh: 修改 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the workspace is the default workspace. Valid values:

false: The workspace is not the default workspace.

true: The workspace is the default workspace
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认工作空间，可能值：
false：不是默认工作空间。
true：是默认工作空间

Owner.description_en: The information about the workspace owner. This parameter is returned only when Verbose is set to true
Owner.description_zh: 工作空间所有者信息，当Verbose为true时显示

Status.description_en:
The status of the workspace. Valid values:

ENABLED: The workspace is running as normal.

INITIALIZING: The workspace is being initialized.

FAILURE: The workspace failed to be created.

DISABLED: The workspace is manually disabled.

FROZEN: The workspace is frozen due to an overdue payment.

UPDATING: The workspace is being updated
Status.description_zh:
工作空间状态，可能值：

ENABLED：正常。
INITIALIZING：初始化中。
FAILURE：失败。
DISABLED：手动禁用。
FROZEN：欠费冻结。
UPDATING：项目更新中

WorkspaceName.title_en: 项目空间名称， region 内唯一
WorkspaceName.title_zh: 项目空间名称， region 内唯一
